visibility.admin: You're an admin and see every meeting in the company.
visibility.placed: You see the meetings of {group}, every team below it and the whole company.
visibility.unplaced: You don't have a place in the company yet. You only see meetings you start or attend. An admin places you under People.

start.title: Start a meeting
start.text: You choose who the meeting is for before you start. The Doc and the summary go only to people who may see the meeting.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.emptyText: The meetings you may see show up here. Start the first one above.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: A customer is added by itself when someone from another company is invited to the meeting in your calendar. Only the e-mail domain is stored, never addresses.
customers.emptyText: Connect your calendar and start a meeting with a guest from another company. The customer then shows up here.
customers.meetings: {count, plural, =0 {No meetings you can see} one {# meeting} other {# meetings}}
customers.tasks: {count, plural, =0 {no open tasks} one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
customers.noMeetings: You can't see any meetings with this customer.

settings.name: Name
settings.inviteText: Whoever opens the link joins without a place in the tree. Then place them under People & groups.
settings.adminsText: Admins (for example the CEO and management) see every meeting, customer and task and can change the tree.
settings.dangerText: Every meeting, note and customer is deleted. The Docs in Google Drive stay with whoever started the meeting.
settings.leaveText: You'll no longer see the company's meetings. An admin can invite you again.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Simon Says crops it to a square. It only shows here in Simon Says – on the company page and in the list – never in the meeting documents.
settings.websiteIntro: Shown at the top of the company page for all colleagues. Optional.

picker.label: Meeting for
picker.privateHint: Only you, the attendees you tick and admins see the meeting.
picker.seesWhole: Who sees it: everyone in the company with a place in the tree.
picker.seesPrivate: Who sees it: you, the attendees you tick and admins.
picker.seesGroup: Who sees it: {group}, the managers above and admins.
picker.eventHint: The meeting then gets the event's name, and the colleagues you tick below count as attendees and see the meeting, even a private one.
picker.noColleagues: No colleagues are invited to the event.
picker.seesAttendees: {count, plural, one {Plus # attendee you ticked.} other {Plus # attendees you ticked.}}

forening.privateHint: Only you and the association's admins see the meeting.
forening.seesWhole: Who sees it: everyone in the association with a place in the tree.
forening.seesPrivate: Who sees it: you and admins.

list.title: Companies
list.intro: Each company has its tree of groups, its meetings and its customers.
list.emptyTitle: You're not in any company yet
list.emptyText: An admin of the company adds you. Have you got an invite link? Open it and you'll end up in the right place.
list.createText: A company has a tree of groups. Everyone sees their group's meetings and everything below it. Tasks are suggested, never required.
list.name: Company name
list.limit: Companies don't count toward the limit of 10 associations you created yourself.

groups.title: Who reports to whom
groups.offIntro: Want to split the association up? Draw who reports to whom, for example the chair at the top with the leads below. Then everyone sees their own team's meetings and every meeting of the teams below their level. Admins see everything. A task for someone who can't see the meeting waits for approval first.
groups.offNow: Off right now: every member sees every meeting.
groups.turnOnText: Everyone an admin has linked to a name in the list starts at the top and sees everything as before. Nothing changes until you draw who reports to whom.
groups.turnOnUnplaced: {count, plural, one {# member isn't linked by an admin (no name in the list, or linked themselves). They then only see meetings they start or attend, and lose access to meeting documents Simon Says shared, until you place them.} other {# members aren't linked by an admin (no name in the list, or linked themselves). They then only see meetings they start or attend, and lose access to meeting documents Simon Says shared, until you place them.}}
groups.onNow: On: everyone sees their own team's meetings and every meeting of the teams below their level. At Start you choose which team the meeting is for.
groups.turnOffText: Every member then sees every group's meetings again. Private meetings stay private: only whoever started them and admins see them. The groups and places are kept if you turn it on again.

tree.title: People
tree.intro: Who reports to whom. Everyone sees their own team's meetings and every meeting of the teams below their level. Admins see everything.
tree.readOnly: Only admins can change the tree.
tree.help: Drag a card to move it. Drag from a person's bottom edge to another person's top edge: the other person then reports to the first.
tree.keyboardHelp: Tab selects a card, the arrow keys move it (Shift: further), Enter edits the person and Delete removes the arrow above.
tree.readOnlyHelp: Only admins can change the tree. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom.
tree.nodeDescription: The arrow keys move the card, Enter edits the person, Delete removes the arrow above.
tree.edgeDescription: Press Delete to remove the arrow.
tree.nodeLabel: {name}{role, select, none {} other {, {role}}}. {manager, select, none {At the top} other {Reports to {manager}}}. {reports, plural, =0 {} one {# person reports to {name}.} other {# people report to {name}.}}
tree.reports: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody below} one {# below} other {# below}}
tree.unplacedText: They see only meetings they start or attend. Drag someone onto a card, or choose who they report to.
tree.unplacedDrop: Drop here: the person leaves the tree.
tree.personLabel: {name}{you, select, yes { (you)} other {}}. Press Enter to choose who they report to.
tree.name: Name
tree.emailHint: With an e-mail the person is linked to their account when they join.
tree.topHint: At the top you see every meeting below you.

refused.cycle: {child} can't report to {manager}: {manager} already reports to {child}, directly or further down.
refused.depth: The tree would get too deep.
refused.missing: That person is no longer in the tree.
refused.hasReports: {name} has people under them. Move them first.
refused.notPlaced: {manager} has no place in the tree yet. Give {manager} a place first.

tree.detachText: {child} goes to the top and then sees every meeting below them, not just in {team}.
tree.removeConfirm: Yes, take {name} out of the tree
tree.removeText: {name} then sees only meetings they start or attend.
